content.short: Impact Web 3 provides blockchain-based solutions for verifiable environmental and social impact on Cardano.
content.description: Impact Web 3 is a sustainability-focused ecosystem on Cardano dedicated to verifiable environmental and social impact. The platform utilizes 'Proof of Impact' (PIP) technology and dynamic NFTs to capture and quantify real-world data directly on the blockchain. Through Domino DAO, the project connects impact-driven initiatives with funding and measurement frameworks, ensuring transparency and accountability. By aligning blockchain innovation with global sustainability goals, Impact Web 3 empowers communities to track and reward positive contributions to society in a decentralized way.
